The layout analysis listed 7 charts, but the figure has 11 panels. I recorded all 11 under ids 1-11 in reading order.

I recorded only the Correct (dark green) segment of each bar, 37 bars in each of the 11 panels (407 points). The ZOP, EOP, NOP, Error and Incorrect segments are not recorded, so the segments of a bar do not sum to 100. That is most of the stacked data, because the small segments are hard to size at this resolution.

The printed percentage labels on the bars are blurred at this resolution and could not be read. Every Correct value is estimated from bar height and snapped to a multiple of 100/N for the panel's question count. Expect an error of about 1-3 points, and larger for the narrow, crowded Llama and Gemini bars.

The category names are my reading of the rotated tick labels, which are low-resolution. Some of the names (e.g. medicineLM-7b-Q8, OpenBioLLM-8b-Q8, Llama3-8b/Llama3.1 variants) may be misread. The 37-bar order follows the same groups in every panel.
